items.defect: anchors.select_donors wrote {selected: ...}; loop passed that record to allocator.select_donor expecting a list (KeyError 0).
items.fix: donors.selected_donors / load_donor_bank_v2 reject v1 records; decide_and_evaluate uses selected_donors(bank, family_depth).

items.defect: DONOR_SELECTOR.json declared policy names with no fitted A4 donor-ranking model.
items.fix: DonorRanker fit on training; DONOR_SELECTOR_MODELS.json + DONOR_SELECTOR_TRAINING/TUNING jsonl.

items.defect: select_donor(..., policy='learned') used allocator RidgeModel as a donor model.
items.fix: allocator.RidgeModel.kind=a4_option_allocator; select_donor raises if ranker is RidgeModel; DonorRanker is separate.

items.defect: Training compared only classical vs always_c1 at p=1, omitted C0 and p=2, dropped identical-plan cases.
items.fix: Training executes classical_only and all four family/depths at every budget; zero-utility labels retained.

items.defect: Allocator feature vector omitted generator option, depth, budget, K, predicted latency (not g(z,m,b)).
items.fix: option_feature_row one-hots options and includes nominal_budget_s, remaining, k, pool, pred_latency_s.

items.defect: Tuning wrote frozen values without actually selecting donor policy, depth, comparator, regularisation, or threshold.
items.fix: Donor policies compared on all tuning parents; allocator lambdas [0.1,1,10]; winner recorded in DONOR_POLICY_SELECTION.json.

items.defect: family_spec overwrote every split with partition=development and erased train/tune/calib identity.
items.fix: ScenarioSpec.partition remains the Stage-2 legal fixture 'development'; scientific identity is namespace a4.{train|tune|calib|anchor} and PreparedCase.split. finaltest/test/shift raise.

items.defect: extract_causal_view used absolute race-clock as remaining decision time.
items.fix: effective_remaining_s = max(0, effective_end_race_s - decision_time_race_s); features use remaining duration.

items.defect: deadline_s argument did not change RaceSimulator spec budget (always 30 s).
items.fix: spec_with_budget / decide_and_evaluate writes primary_nominal_budget_s into the spec the simulator reads.

items.defect: pred_latency_s=0.05 hard-coded in dispatch.
items.fix: dispatch uses feats['pred_latency_s'] from the option/allocator row, defaulting to 0 only if missing.

items.defect: Arrival delay contained only generation_s.
items.fix: precommit_s sums menu/QUBO, generation, and planning-sim; that uncapped total is arrival_delay_s.

items.defect: Arrival and common-commit delays were min-capped, concealing lateness.
items.fix: timings.uncapped=True; no min(deadline, ...) on arrival_delay_s.

items.defect: cache_key omitted budget, arrival, commitment epoch, simulator/interface version, evaluator identity.
items.fix: banks.cache_key hashes those fields; tests show each field changes identity.

items.defect: Every arm reinitialised the simulator and rebuilt menu/QUBO/enumeration/MILP.
items.fix: PreparedCase created once per (partition, block, regime); campaign passes legal_table and spec_with_budget.

items.defect: Campaign never passed family_depth; quantum arms defaulted to p=1.
items.fix: decide_and_evaluate family_depth argument; campaign iterates C0_p1/C0_p2/C1_p1/C1_p2.

items.defect: n_stochastic_seeds=3 expanded only classical generators; quantum ran one seed.
items.fix: assemble_portfolio loops n_stochastic_seeds quantum pools and stores seed_receipts.

items.defect: Hybrid inserted quantum first, could drop the classical incumbent, and labelled shared plans origin=quantum.
items.fix: Matched K: fallback + strongest classical incumbent protected; quantum fills residual slots only.

items.defect: Candidate provenance was a single string; shared plans counted as quantum-exclusive.
items.fix: found_by set; merge on duplicate hashes; quantum_incremental_at_k only if absent from matched classical K.

items.defect: Planning and evaluation simulations were per-arm instead of once per complete cache key.
items.fix: _simulate_plan_world uses full cache_key; evaluation bank rejected from planning helpers.

items.defect: Offline reference unrun; copied arm loss.
items.fix: evaluate_offline_reference evaluates every legal plan on offline planning bank; copied_from_arm=False.

items.defect: Preflight undercounted arms/depths/seeds/offline and charged new anchors.
items.fix: Admission measures real end-to-end witnesses, reuses 288 anchors, projects ladder against 60 min / 20% reserve.

items.defect: Training loop caught structural exceptions and repeated them across the corpus.
items.fix: StructuralError fails on first occurrence; coordinator cancels and exits nonzero.

items.defect: verify.py counted failed training as parent completion, empty paired analysis, first-80 manifest, no donor/budget/q checks.
items.fix: Independent verifier hashes every manifest entry, recomputes q, uses status-specific required files, includes PRESTART_QUARANTINE.

items.defect: Forced-quantum test appended a fake hash; classical/hybrid difference allowed none; offline test did not execute offline.
items.fix: Real quantum hashes from legal table; offline helper executed; difference not required to be favourable.

items.defect: START_STATE.json hard-coded obsolete be9e11 start commit.
items.fix: START_STATE binds bcc740cd71ea5b6367b9332a300bf89590656ffc and the reviewed source commit at admission.

items.defect: Test receipts copied from global /tmp/a4_test_receipts.
items.fix: Development writes only .scratch/; admission writes evidence/stage6_a4/<run_id>/tests/.

items.defect: Gate E could pass merely because legal_plan_count > K.
items.fix: Gate E requires a genuine matched-K quantum-incremental-at-K candidate generated and planning-evaluated.

items.defect: Gate F checked superficial counts and flawed preflight boolean.
items.fix: Gate F requires 24 calibration parents, q, MC uncertainty, Stage 7 sizing, and measured resources.

items.defect: Report called calibration a primary analysis and claimed five budgets while only 30 s executed.
items.fix: Closure report labels calibration DEVELOPMENT ONLY; campaign iterates the five-budget grid on training.
